method: Read-only authenticated GitHub metadata, complete recursive trees and selected source text pinned to commit; external license metadata only. No patient datasets or new model archives downloaded. No source modules blindly merged.
scope: All ten repositories named in mission. This is provenance inspection, not clinical validation.
